title: Surreal Dream Canal
description: A vibrant surreal scene set in a narrow stone alleyway with a canal. A large central woman's face with colorful patterned skin is held by multiple disembodied hands, her hair transforming into flowing pink and teal ribbons that drip from the sky above a distant castle.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene inside a narrow stone alley with cracked walls and ivy. A giant stylized woman's face with multicolored patterned skin floats in the center, mouth open, held by several disembodied hands of different colors including red, grey, and purple. Her hair merges into flowing pink and teal liquid ribbons dripping from the sky. Below is a canal with a black gondola carrying a silhouetted figure and a white horse standing on the bank among blue flowers and red poppies. A distant dark castle sits under a blue sky with crescent moons. Red handprints and eyes are visible on the cobblestone path in the foreground.
